title: THE FRONTIER WEEK · The sawmill
venue: the Newport paper · a western week the editor cut · Box 3
logline: The sawmill up the road with its whistle — the stranger's dog howls at it — and the mill boss asking the stranger if he's looking for work. He says he's looking for the stump. The boss says which one. The stranger points at the ridge. There are ten thousand stumps. He says that one.

panels.composition: A frontier sawmill with a steam whistle blowing a jagged shape; the dog howling at it.
